cases.name: Melanie "Rochelle" Meyers
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Melanie worked as a Chief Financial Officer for many years and most recently was self-employed.

Melanie discovered her passion for writing early in high school, where she began to create stories and express her artistry through words. Melaine truly loved animals, horseback riding, listening to music, and making crafts. She found great joy in spending time outdoors with her pets and always looked forward to discovering new creative projects. Music was a constant companion especially her favorite band Air Supply, bringing her comfort and inspiration throughout her days. She also spent much of her time tending to her hair and make-up which she took great pride in."
cases.narrative:
On 1/20/2026, deputies with the Huntington County Sheriff’s Department arrived at the scene – which was not the couple’s home, according to the release – a man and woman were found dead on a lower-level floor.

“Evidence at the scene indicated the two had been there for some time and both had been shot,” the release described.

Relatives of the property owner had told dispatch they hadn’t seen the couple “for some time,” but their vehicle was parked on the property, according to a press release the coroner shared Wednesday.
